summary: Dashboard time-series shows transient spikes when tracing hook updates trace tags
description: Issue summary: BrightCart reports recurring, short-lived spikes on several dashboard time-series immediately after their application emits a tracing-hook that updates custom trace tags. Impact: Reports are noisy and alert thresholds (P99 latency and request counts) are tripping; affects three business dashboards used for capacity decisions. Environment: prod (us-east), dedicated org org-874. Observed behavior: When a tracing-hook updates tag "experiment_group" on an active trace, the dashboard line charts show a 5–15 second high-amplitude spike in request counts and client-side latency metrics that is not reflected in raw API logs. The anomaly correlates with the timestamp of the tag-write; spikes are visible in the console UI and in cached hourly rollups but do not appear in the ingestion pipeline raw event stream.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer reproducer: Attach tracing hook that patches trace.tags.experiment_group after trace is created
2) Generate sustained traffic (~80 RPS) with the tag update happening for ~10% of requests
3) Open customer dashboard (last 30 minutes) and observe sudden short spikes aligned to tag updates
4) Query raw events in Log Service for same timeframe: no matching spike in ingestion counts
5) Toggle dashboard time range to smaller window (last 5 minutes) — spikes remain visible in UI but aggregation view shows bucketization artifacts
logs: Support note: Kibana query for org-874: index=console-metrics-* metric=request_count OR metric=client_latency | time >= "2026-03-10T14:20:00Z"
Console frontend (Sentry) snapshot: https://sentry.redwood.ai/issue/console-frontend/abc123 — shows UI re-render at 14:21:07Z with sudden series delta
Ingestion pipeline tail: https://logs.redwood.ai/org-874/streams/ingest?from=2026-03-10T14:15:00Z — no matching peak in raw messages
comments: 2026-03-10 14:35 Aisha Patel (Support): Customer reports spiky charts starting after midnight deploy. Can reproduce on their org. Attached screenshots and repro script.

2026-03-10 15:02 Marco Ruiz (SRE): Initial triage: spikes correlate with UI refreshes and a query cache miss. Opening console dashboard query logs. Pushing to In Progress and tagging tracing-hooks team.

2026-03-11 09:18 Elodie Chen (Frontend Eng): Observed that series identity key changes when trace.tags.* updates; frontend merges new series into time bucket duplicate causing temporary amplification. PR candidate to normalize series keys drafted.
2026-03-11 11:40 Aisha Patel (Support): Shared temporary workaround with customer (disable post-create tag updates in tracing hook) — customer applied and spikes disappeared in their dashboards.

2026-03-12 08:05 Marco Ruiz (SRE): Correlated change introduced in deploy tag: console@release-2026-03-09; raising potential regression backlog item. Referencing PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2481
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Frontend series key uses a combination of metric+tag map hash. When a tag is written later, the hash for existing series changes and front-end double-counts (old key + new key) until cache eviction.
Hypothesis 2: Backend rollup job emits a second partial bucket when meta updates are observed mid-bucket; rollup merges incorrectly leading to a transient spike.
Observed: Raw ingest counts do not show the spike. Frontend network traces show duplicate websocket 'series_update' messages within 2s of the tag-write event.
Trace logs: tracing-hook update call at 14:21:07Z for traceId=tr-9b2f; frontend received series_update for metric=request_count at 14:21:08Z and again at 14:21:09Z with different 'series_id' field.
Frontend patch in review: normalizeSeriesKey() to use stable label ordering + fill-missing-tags placeholder. Backend team investigating rollup commit behavior when tag deltas are present mid-bucket.
workaround: Disable post-create trace tag mutations in customer tracing-hooks (recommended) or narrow dashboard time range to avoid the affected bucket. Support provided a one-line workaround script to avoid updating tags after trace creation.
resolution: Investigating; temporary mitigation applied by customer (disabled tag updates). Frontend PR created to normalize series keys; backend rollup review pending. Target: patch release in next minor window.
notes_for_followup: Action item: Add unit tests to ensure stable series id across tag updates
Action item: Add an entry to the runbook (confluence) describing observable symptoms and mitigation steps
